2117619305479286993.en_summary: @justinsuntron says his lawyers moved to sanction World Liberty Financial for failing to disclose UAE citizenship until months into his litigation. He invested $30M then $45M in $WLFI tokens, sued in April over alleged fraud and frozen tokens, and argues the late UAE disclosure aims to strip federal jurisdiction.
2117619305479286993.zh_summary: @justinsuntron 稱其律師已申請制裁 World Liberty Financial，指對方直至訴訟數月後才披露阿聯酋公民身分。他先後投資 3000 萬再加至 4500 萬美元 $WLFI 代幣，4 月以涉嫌欺詐及凍結代幣提告，並指遲來的阿聯酋披露意在剝奪聯邦法院管轄權。

2117621018391142894.en_summary: @justinsuntron quotes his own $WLFI litigation thread, saying World Liberty was proudly American when selling tokens and discovered UAE roots only when it needed a way out of federal court.
2117621018391142894.zh_summary: @justinsuntron 引用自己關於 $WLFI 訴訟的帖文，稱 World Liberty 在銷售代幣時標榜美國身分，卻在需要退出聯邦法庭時才發現阿聯酋背景。
